pu.title: 1st PUC admission documents

items.text: Class X annual examination marks statement
Class X annual examination hall ticket
items.note: Verifies the parent's name. If you do not have it, bring the original Class X marks statement.

items.text: Caste certificate issued by the Government of Karnataka
items.note: Only if you are claiming a caste-category benefit.

items.text: PEN (Permanent Education Number) issued by your school

non_state.text: Consumer Number and Provisional Eligibility Certificate
non_state.note: ICSE, CBSE and other-board candidates must get a Consumer Number to generate the Provisional Eligibility Certificate. Enter your details exactly as on your Class X marks card. Karnataka State Board candidates do not need this.

steps: A secure payment link is emailed to your registered email address
